name: Perplexity Comet
description: Comet is a web browser from Perplexity with a built-in AI assistant that answers questions about pages, summarizes content and can perform tasks such as emailing, shopping or research while you browse. It is available for Mac, Windows, iOS and Android. Comet has been free to download and use since October 2025; an optional Comet Plus subscription costs $5/month and is included with Perplexity Pro and Max.
